title: Oven Braised British Beef Stew
description: A spicy and flavorful British dish featuring slow-cooked beef in a rich cooking wine sauce, perfect for a cold winter's night. This recipe is gluten-free-friendly and showcases the best of British cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the beef cubes with salt, black pepper, and thyme.
Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat and sear the beef cubes until browned on all sides.
Add the cooking wine, beef broth, tomato paste, and Worcestershire sauce to the Dutch oven and stir to combine.
Add the sliced carrots and cubed potatoes to the Dutch oven and stir to combine.
Cover the Dutch oven with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the stew in the oven for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender and the vegetables are cooked through.
Remove the Dutch oven from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
